_meta.note: Source strings. Every other language falls back to these.

undo.sensei: No worries. Tap Undo if that was a slip.
mode.title: Show all features
mode.hint: Simple mode shows the core screens. Turn this on to see everything. Nothing is ever deleted.
mode.sensei: I will keep it simple for now. More unlocks as you go.
lang.title: Language
lang.hint: Menus, coach messages and reminders. Anything not translated yet stays in English.
lang.review: Hindi, Telugu and Tamil are first drafts and still need a native review.
next.breakfast.text: Good morning! Log your breakfast, even a rough guess is fine.
next.water-am.text: A glass of water first thing is an easy start.
next.lunch.text: Lunch time. Log it when you eat, so the day stays simple.
next.water.text: Your water is a little behind. A glass now helps.
next.steps.text: A 10-minute walk fits nicely into this part of the day.
next.fix.text: A little over today is fine. Want a light plan for the rest of the day?
next.dinner.text: Dinner time. Log it so tomorrow can build on today.
next.weight.text: It is your weigh-in day. A quick entry is enough.
next.wind-down.text: Nice work today. Prepare tomorrow's plan, then rest well.
next.late-lunch.text: Did you eat lunch? Log it so your day stays accurate.
next.steady.text: You are on track. Log what you eat as you go.
palette.title: Quick add
palette.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. water 250, weight 70.5, food rice
palette.hint: Enter to run · Esc to close
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.goto: Go to Home / Food / Plan / Progress
notif.water: Time for a glass of water
notif.breakfast: Breakfast time. A quick log is enough.
notif.lunch: Lunch time. Log it when you eat.
notif.dinner: Dinner time. Log it so tomorrow can build on today.
say.welcome: Welcome. I am your sensei here. We start small.
say.palette: Quick add ready. Type what you did.
